data.scenario:
The Watanabe School of Traditional Sumo Arts is more like a temple than a gym.

The floors are polished daily to a mirror sheen. The tatami mats are snow-white, custom imported from Kyoto and replaced monthly. The walls are adorned with calligraphy scrolls and carefully maintained bonsai trees. Every room smells faintly of incense and fresh bamboo, a quiet calm humming through the air like a monastery. The students are expected to arrive early, wash thoroughly, and bow before every spar.

Everything is immaculate. Sacred. Silent.
